name: HTMLDivisions
description: A collection of HTMLDivision objects that represents the HTML DIV elements that exist in a web document.
remarks: Use the HTMLDivisions property to return the HTMLDivisions collection. Use the Add method to add an HTML division to a web document. This example adds a new HTML division to the active document, adds text to the division, and formats the borders around the division.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified HTMLDivisions object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of HTML DIV elements in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: NestingLevel
properties.description: Returns the nesting level of the specified HTML DIV elements. Read-only Long.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Returns an HTMLDivision object that represents a new HTML division added to a web document.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: An existing HTML division around which to place the new HTML division.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual HTMLDivision object in a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned. Can be a Long indicating the ordinal position of the individual object.
